analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 34.9, entering oversold territory, continuing decline from 41.5 five days ago. MACD histogram worsening to -2.7303, in bearish convergence. ADX at 24.1, in early trend formation stage, but -DI (35.1) is dominant over +DI (13.1). 5-day low $321.02, 20-day low $321.02, failing to confirm Higher Low. Current price $323.24 is near the lower Bollinger Band at $322.76. Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for 15 consecutive sessions. Overall market QQQ is down 1.5%. Technical indicators show selling pressure dominance rather than buying, but ADX below 25 suggests trend is not yet confirmed, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
